Topic.label: Classification of Real Numbers and Representation on the Number Line

Question: Which of the following statements is correct?

Choices.A: Real numbers correspond one-to-one with points on the number line.
Choices.B: All points on the number line represent rational numbers.
Choices.C: Real numbers are divided into two categories: positive real numbers and negative real numbers.

Solution: Points on the number line represent both rational and irrational numbers, and real numbers correspond one-to-one with points on the number line. Real numbers are divided into three categories: positive real numbers, \(0\), and negative real numbers. \(0\) is rational.
